sections.title: Quick Audio Converter
sections.subtitle: Single-track high-fidelity transcoding and export modal.

sections.title: Source Track Information
sections.details: Displays source file path, duration, audio format, bit depth, sample rate, and channel configuration.

sections.title: Quick Target Preset Selection
sections.details: Select target preset: FLAC (Lossless Level 5) | WAV (24-bit PCM) | MP3 (320kbps CBR) | AAC (256kbps) | Opus (160kbps VBR).

sections.title: Export Location & Execution
sections.details: Target folder: Source file folder. Click 'Execute Transcode' to dispatch non-blocking background task.
